## Honest partial coverage

One game — **Los Angeles Dodgers @ Chicago Cubs** (gamePk 824647, 20:05 ET first pitch) — had no
posted markets at generation time. It is represented as uncovered, not fabricated. The top-up
decision script confirms it as the single eligible candidate ("1 scheduled pregame game(s) still
lack market coverage").

**No credits were spent chasing it overnight.** At 00:45 ET the game was 19.5 hours away and its
books were plainly not posted; spending ~62 credits to rediscover that would be waste. The
designed automation owns it: the 09:30 ET scheduled generation (whole slate still pregame — safe
under the slate-safety rule) and the 15:30 ET append-only top-up. Recorded in
`AUG3_APPEND_ONLY_COVERAGE_PROOF.md`.

## Policy compliance

No model weights, calibration parameters, thresholds, or market policy changed. Restricted
markets (total bases) remain disabled. Research-only families (pitcher workload, lineups, market
movement) were **not** promoted into the production model. The board was generated exactly once
from valid pregame inputs.
